description: Redesign FeedingView, ExpensesView, PerformanceView, AdvisorView, and VaccinationsView. Depends on FEAT-001, FEAT-002, FEAT-003. Same migration pattern: kf-* classes, ui.tsx components, inline error state, Modal deletes. PerformanceView adds CssBar charts (no library). AdvisorView adds structured suggested-questions panel, graceful AI-unavailable notice. VaccinationsView adds grouped reminder sections with status badges. No API call changes. No type changes in farm.ts.

For each group filter vaccinations by status and render a kf-table-wrap/kf-table with columns: Vaccine Name, Species, Target, Date Due, Date Administered, Count, Status, Notes, Actions. findings: All five views rewritten with kf-* classes and ui.tsx components. FeedingView: StatCards for totalKg/totalBags/totalCost/recordCount, Segmented animal filter, Modal delete confirm, no alert() calls, all FeedingRecord fields including cost/supplier/notes. ExpensesView: CssBar category breakdowns for both income/expense tabs, Modal delete confirm, no alert() calls. PerformanceView: CssBar charts for income/expense categories, population/mortality/production/feed panels, CSV export preserved. AdvisorView: two-column kf-grid--main-side layout, Segmented period selector, rule-based warnings panel, AI advisory panel with graceful unavailable Notice, FarmChatbot, 5 suggested question chips, summary StatCards. VaccinationsView: grouped reminder sections (overdue/due today/upcoming 7 days/completed) with status Badges, schedules table + add form, full add form with all VaccinationRecord fields, Modal mark-done. Build: tsc -b && vite build — exit 0, zero TypeScript errors.
